checks.name: Two booked slots produce independent tickets and stable doctor/room snapshots
Invalid QR, missing GPS and outside-geofence requests do not check in
A correctly signed expired hospital QR is rejected by the live service
Wrong reception room and unassigned doctor cannot activate/start the ticket
Repeated check-in is idempotent and per-appointment status does not show another ticket
Cancelling a checked-in appointment invalidates its queue ticket
Historical appointment and ticket snapshots do not restore a revoked owner

note: Initial harness expected HTTP 401 without a certificate; the live server requires a certificate at TLS handshake. Confirmed with separate transport checks.
